title: 第21章 不再是榜首的榜首1第22章 不再是榜首的榜首2
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
临近午夜的时候，温郗缓缓睁开了眼眸，眼眸一转，放在了自己屁股旁边的小草上。
在温郗的视线中，那棵小草时不时随着夜风摇摆，顶端还凝着水露，看起来再正常不过了。
温郗却看着看着缓缓皱起了眉。
温郗：‘小明，你有听到什么吗？’
小明的声音有一瞬间的卡壳：‘什，什么？’
温郗：‘有人在……’
她形容不出来这个感觉，索性又闭上眼睛，用识海和灵力去捕捉空气中的波动。
………
时间一分一秒过去，温郗总算捕捉到了诡异之处——
她身边的草木都在以不同的频率震动着，有的缓慢，有的急切，错综交杂，甚至有的似乎还在互相配合。
温郗微微偏头，引导着木系灵力试着跟随那些震动频率复刻。
下一瞬，温郗明显察觉到那些震动都凝滞了一瞬。
她抿唇，也收了灵力。
可没过多久，那些震动再次出现，只不过换了一种截然不同的节奏。
它似乎……
在试探自己是否真的能感应到它的存在……
温郗再度调动灵力，同方才一样，再次让灵力跟随那些节奏共舞。
这一次，那莫名的震动没有停顿，没有凝滞，而是迅速又换了一种节奏，温郗有条不紊地进行调整。
几次试探下来，那些震动再次消失，这一次，隔了许久都未曾再出现。
温郗缓缓睁开双眼，回忆刚刚所有的节奏。

不知道为什么，她从那些震动里察觉到了……
情绪。
是的，没错，情绪。
第一次出现的节奏里带着忧伤，第二次是则是惊讶，第三次似乎是好奇，第四次的她猜应该是期待……
温郗挑眉。
会是那个嫌她唱歌难听的大佬吗？
那人练得是什么功法？
这么奇特，大半夜的操控草木在这发癫？
这些节奏要是能发出声音估计还能谱成一首曲子呢。
上辈子温郗那个破身体没什么娱乐活动，除了看书刷视频就是听歌听曲了。刚刚投入进去和鸣的时候，她恍惚间又想起了那些过往。
周围的一切再度恢复了寂静，温郗静下心来，重新运转灵力，继续修炼。
——————
第二天上完课后，温郗赶到典籍司的时候，发现那里竟然排起了长队。
长到一眼望不到头。
温郗：？
content_en:
When midnight was approaching, Wen Xi slowly opened his eyes, turned his eyes, and placed them on the grass next to his butt.
In Wen Xi's sight, the grass swayed with the night wind from time to time, and there was still dew on the top. It looked perfectly normal.
Wen Xi slowly frowned as he watched.
Wen Xi: ‘Xiao Ming, did you hear anything? ’
Xiao Ming's voice was stuck for a moment: 'What, what? ’
Wen Xi: 'Someone is here...'
She couldn't describe the feeling, so she simply closed her eyes again and used her sea of consciousness and spiritual power to capture the fluctuations in the air.
………
As time passed by, Wen Xi finally caught something strange——
The vegetation around her was vibrating at different frequencies, some slowly, some eagerly, intricately, and some even seemed to be cooperating with each other.
Wen Xi tilted his head slightly and guided the wood spiritual power to try to reproduce those vibration frequencies.
The next moment, Wen Xi clearly noticed that the vibrations froze for a moment.
She pursed her lips and collected her spiritual power.
But not long after, those vibrations appeared again, but with a completely different rhythm.
It seems...
Trying to see if I can really sense its existence...
Wen Xi once again mobilized his spiritual power, just like before, and once again let his spiritual power dance with those rhythms.
This time, the inexplicable vibration did not pause or stagnate, but quickly changed to a different rhythm, and Wen Xi adjusted it methodically.
After several attempts, those vibrations disappeared again. This time, they did not appear again after a long time.
Wen Xi slowly opened his eyes and recalled all the rhythms just now.
She didn't know why, but she noticed it from those vibrations...
emotions.
Yes, that’s right, emotions.
The first time it appeared there was sadness in its rhythm, the second time it was surprise, the third time it seemed to be curiosity, and the fourth time she guessed it was anticipation...
Wen Xi raised his eyebrows.
Could she be the boss who thinks her singing is ugly?
What kind of skills did that person practice?
It's so strange, manipulating plants and trees to go crazy here in the middle of the night?
If these rhythms could make sounds, they could probably be composed into a piece of music.
In his previous life, Wen Xi had a broken body and had no entertainment activities. Apart from reading books and watching videos, he only listened to music. When she just got involved in harmonizing, she suddenly remembered those past events again.
Everything around him returned to silence again, and Wen Xi calmed down, started to use his spiritual power again, and continued to practice.
——————
After class the next day, when Wen Xi rushed to the Classics Department, he found that there was a long queue there.
It's so long that it can't be seen at a glance.
Wen Xi:?
